function.arguments: {"observation": "The `revenue` column is stored as a string with commas (e.g., '1,234.56'), and the data contains 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99. These must be removed before any revenue-based analysis, as they will heavily skew averages and totals.", "implication": "Any calculation involving revenue — including totals, averages, or group means — must exclude the QA orders. Failure to do so will produce misleading results. This affects all revenue-related analysis, including the fraction of conversions, if it is computed using a subset that includes these outliers. However, since we are only computing a conversion fraction (a binary proportion), and the QA orders are not necessarily tied to conversion, we must check whether they are included in the group of interest. But even if they are not, we must remove them from the dataset entirely to avoid contamination in any downstream use of revenue. Thus, we must filter them out before any analysis."}
function.name: note_finding
